faq.label: COMMON QUERIES
faq.intro: Find answers to technical specifications, deployment timelines, and our data security protocols.
faq.heading: Everything you need to know about our AI.

items.q: How do you ensure our data remains secure?
items.a: We utilize SOC2-compliant local vector databases and on-premise LLM hosting to ensure your proprietary data never leaves your infrastructure.

items.q: What is the typical deployment timeline?
items.a: Initial neural audits take 1 week, followed by a 4-week rapid prototyping phase before full-scale production deployment.

items.q: Can we integrate with our existing CRM?
items.a: Yes, our cognitive pipelines are built with native API connectors for Salesforce, HubSpot, and custom enterprise ERP systems.
Absolutely. We offer bespoke fine-tuning services to align open-source models (like Llama 3) with your specific industry terminology and logic.

items.q: How do you calculate ROI for automation?
items.a: We track "Inference-to-Impact" metrics, measuring hours saved and accuracy gains against your previous baseline manual workflows.

items.q: Do we own the custom code you build?
items.a: Yes. All custom neural architectures and integration code developed for your firm are 100% owned by you upon project completion.

items.q: What models do you specialize in?
items.a: We are model-agnostic, specializing in OpenAI, Anthropic, and Mistral, as well as local deployments of high-performance open-source LLMs.
